thread:
Alyssa: Quick sync 14 launching the Tugboat co-sell pilot with NorthCloud next quarter. Need to lock lead-ownership rules and announcement guardrails.

Matt S: +1. Can we pick a default claim window so leads dont sit? I vote 48h.

Jordan: Id prefer 72h unless a demo is pre-booked. Gives field time to prep.

Tasha: For named accounts: field owns initial outreach. For inbound SI-sourced leads, SI owns until an SDR/AE touches the lead. If AE replies, ownership transfers.

Sam E: Proposed ingest CSV schema: `account_alias,account_id,owner,source,claim_deadline_iso,demo_scheduled`. Example row: `acme-inc,AC-123,Tasha,SI,2026-05-02T17:00Z,true`. We will validate `claim_deadline_iso` server-side.

Alyssa: Also need roles for joint announcements and marketplace listings: who drafts, review SLA, and embargo windows.

Matt S: Redwood drafts announcement copy; SI gets 3 business days to review. SI creates marketplace listing; Redwood provides logos, sample usage blurb.

Jordan: Add one-week embargo buffer for coordinated PR.

Tasha: Routing to Legal for co-brand approvals.

Alyssa: Ops ask: create #tugboat-partners and weekly triage.

Sam E: Created #tugboat-partners and invited SI PMs. Uploaded templates: https://drive.redwood/si/tugboat/templates. @Matt S please review outreach copy.

deploy-bot: Meeting created: Tugboat partner triage 14 Wednesdays 09:00 PT. Link: https://calendar.redwood.example/evt/abcd

Matt S: Reviewed templates, minor subject/CTA tweaks. Will PR today.

Jordan: Add auto-escalation if no claim within window to prevent cold leads.

Alyssa: Policy: claim_window = 72h, auto_escalate = true. Sam, add `auto_escalate` to schema.

Sam E: Adding `auto_escalate` (boolean) and `escalation_target` (email). Example: `auto_escalate:true,escalation_target:ae@redwood.com`.

Tasha: Security note: demo env tokens must rotate; partner demo keys should have TTL.

Alyssa: Infra/Sam to own token TTL.

Alyssa: Next steps I'll convert to GH issue: finalize CSV schema, approve 72h claim window, confirm auto-escalation, finalize outreach templates, route ROE to Legal, schedule announcement timeline.

Jordan: lgtm.

Matt S: +1 :thumbsup:

Sam E: Opening PR for ingest and pushing template updates this afternoon.

Tasha: I'll follow up with Legal and Security.

Alyssa: Thanks everyone 14 converting to GH issue and pinging reviewers. Closing thread. :rocket:
